repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

One more item for this card, from PR #36383's delta contract review on head 04d28e04 (N3). The rule for which decision branches name a step has two copies. `decisionBranchTechnicalTargets` in `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` restates the edge test of `decisionBranches` in the UI's `flow-branches.ts`, including its own copy of the `default` label, because lint cannot import the UI package. They agree today, but nothing holds them together. While this card touches the step-name readers, move the predicate into `@objectstack/spec/automation` beside `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` so both sides read it. If that isn't possible, add a parity pin and a back-pointer comment on each side.

Blocked-by #36383 is MERGED (19:58Z).

Pre-claim lane: ui reader half (`ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts`, domain:ui) + lint/spec half (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts`, domain:spec); both stay with this seat under area-lease 留道.
Pre-claim deps: `Blocked-by: #36383` → merged; no "after #N"; hot files per the line above.
Prior rulings read: card thread 0 rulings (check-prior-rulings, 2 comments); governing ruling 7076440876 on #35979 item 1, verbatim: "A flow node gets a translatable label key under the flow's translation bundle (spec, validation and the business-view reader), so every drawn step (start, end, decision, notify, approval) can carry a label per language." No ADR decision names a titled screen's label key; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.

Premise reading at 87c7bbaf: `flowStepName` (`metadata-viewer.tsx:407`) falls back to `node.label` when a titled screen's heading holds `{{`; `stepLabel` (`flowLabels.ts:74`) answers `undefined` for a titled screen; the validator refuses a `nodes` key over any `screen` (`validate-translation-references.ts:2575` block). Item 2: `stepLabel`'s untitled-screen arm returns `screens.NODE_ID.title` with no `{{` test. Item from comment 7084469163: `decisionBranchTechnicalTargets` (`i18n-walk.ts:2310`) restates `decisionBranches` (`flow-branches.ts:93`) and its own `'default'` constant.

Key name (seat's call, per the naming rule, precedent named): **`flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label` accepted over a screen that authors its own `config.title`**; an untitled screen stays redirected to `screens.NODE_ID.title`. Precedent: the `nodes` group's own rule in `translation.zod.ts` — "this one addresses the node label of every node whose label has no key of its own" — and a titled screen's label is exactly such a label. The other route, a `screens.NODE_ID.label` member, is not taken: `screens` already aliases `label` onto `title` (`aliases: { label: 'title', … }`), so that spelling today means the heading; reusing it would change what an accepted key means. One string keeps one key either way.
